name: Review the truth and verdicts for a letter

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'Counter' letter on the chart, then click 'Details' in the letter card to open its station
Verify the truth for each version is displayed
Verify TestSprite's verdict and stated reason are displayed for the letter
